purpose: Repository-retained selected standalone Helper results; not product qualification

limits: A complete source/compiler/environment manifest was not recorded for the original campaign; these partial hashes do not establish a complete build identity.

The accounting build only changed processed-aperture counters and 36-second CPU partitions. Every pre-existing non-CPU output field matched the frozen build on the full nominal/profile key1930100001 comparison. This is one regression comparison, not a complete historical source binding.
Rebuild the current tracked sources for new experiments; matching command arguments does not promise the historical binary hash.

configuration.mode_overrides: Each argv selects source-mode overrides in tracked tests/test_helper_complete_study.cpp and tests/helper_transient_fixture.hpp; do not assume these defaults override those modes.
configuration.waveform_variants: no-pilot-ramps / absent or straight auxiliary retain standard normalization; changed energy is labeled by helper_power_reference in each summary.

records.cases.jsonl: 216 full-capture experiment arms plus six serialized CPU repeats; all per-case summary fields, all-selection complete-output metrics, common-v8 diagnostic and correlated profile-reason counts.
records.reservations.json: 48 distinct fixture schedule keys/noise seeds and impairment combinations reserved before tuning. Reused cases across methods/losses are matched comparisons, not independent keys.
records.strict-inversion.json: 80 earlier full-capture strict individual-marker arms, including per-marker errors/intervals; different binary and implementation from pooled study.

aggregation_rules: Independent timing/frequency comparisons use one frozen 36-second result per capture, conditional on availability/qualification.
RMS combines squared errors; phase RMS across regions/cases is weighted by phase_samples. Beginning/interior/end are disjoint; boundary overlaps them and must not be added again.
Per-case p95/p99 values cannot reconstruct a pooled percentile. Report their median/range explicitly instead.
Repeated calendar updates share history; their count/coverage is not an independent sample count.
Noisy probe, clean twin, and evaluator-only pre-probe synthetic tone have separate labels.
Complete-output metrics include uncertain output. Undefined phase at zero clean energy is separately counted.
CPU counters overlap: total receiver and exact36 components are authoritative; profile_release is included in conditioner. Simulation, clean twin, and metrology are separate.
omissions: Raw PCM, binaries, bulk logs, per-dwell likelihood curves, and most chronological debug rows are not included.
Earlier pilot/refinement/EME results remain in tracked narrative studies and tracked reproducer sources; this is not an archive of every historical experiment.
The reserved schedule keys are public test fixtures, not operational secrets.
